'''Adarian ships''' were freighters manufactured by small companies owned by the [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]] government. The Adarians preferred to use technology of their own design, including their own [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] and [[Carbon-Ice Drive]]s. Their ships competed with those of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] and were considered by outsiders to be of exceptional quality.
